title: Updating the vertex count
statement: For any register state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, replacing coordinate $1$ of its register-value vector by $z$ yields the register-value vector of the state obtained by replacing its vertex count by $z$.
replaced:
Let $σ$ be a record of fifteen natural-number registers, and let $R(σ)$ list its
registers in order, with the vertex count at coordinate $1$. Replacing coordinate $1$ of
$R(σ)$ by $z$ gives the register vector of the record obtained from $σ$ by replacing its
vertex count by $z$.
